summary: Tested iter48 International export/import documentation suite — 16 doc types, 10 branded PDF generators, doc tracker CRUD, AES ITN capture, GridFS upload/download, plus DocumentsDrawer UI. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass. Frontend: drawer opens, ITN capture creates auto ITN_RECEIPT tracker entry, all 10 generator buttons render, AES PDF downloads via authedDownload, upload-card attaches PHYTOSANITARY_CERT file, status dropdown updates docs.

issues: Missing aria-describedby/Description on DialogContent — Radix a11y warning in console (non-blocking)

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Add <DialogDescription> to DocumentsDrawer's DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: intl_documents.py is ~1024 lines and approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting markdown generators into a sub-module (e.g. routes/intl_doc_templates.py) if more types are added.
Doc tracker is stored as an embedded array on intl_container_bookings — fine at current scale, but could become unwieldy beyond ~50 docs per booking. Consider a dedicated collection if scale grows.
upload_doc validates doc_type but NOT status against DOC_STATUSES on the explicit branch (defaults to 'RECEIVED' if invalid). That's actually a graceful fallback so OK, but worth documenting.
delete_doc returns ok=true even if the doc_id doesn't exist (no matched_count check). Minor — could return 404 for clarity.

GridFS file is not deleted when a doc tracker entry is deleted (only the embedded record is $pull'd). Risk: orphaned GridFS chunks accumulate over time. Recommend adding bucket.delete(ObjectId(file_id)) in delete_doc.
seed_data_creation: Used existing INTL container bookings from iter47. Test attached docs cleaned up at end. Two bookings now carry AES ITN_RECEIPT trackers (X20260628000999, X20260628000777) from this run — non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_intl_documents.py pass against the live preview URL. Frontend DocumentsDrawer fully functional via /international page — each booking row has a Docs button (data-testid='booking-docs-{id}'). One UX quirk: once an aes_filing is recorded the input form is replaced with a read-only badge; first booking in the list already had ITN X20260628000999 from backend test so use a different row to test the input flow.
